demo_packaging_20261018.blocker_uba: RunUAT -build failed three times with C1083 access-denied on SharedPCH.Engine.Project.ValApi.ValExpApi.Cpp20.h.pch; UbaStorageServer could not write C:/ProgramData/Epic/UnrealBuildAccelerator/cas (SetFileInformationByHandle FileDispositionInfo denied) so the PCH never reached disk. BuildCookRun does not forward -NoUBA to UnrealBuildTool.
demo_packaging_20261018.workaround: Removed the stale cas/.isRunning lock, built Nai_Long and Nai_LongEditor directly through Build.bat with -NoUBA (standard executor), then ran BuildCookRun with -nobuild. Both targets report Succeeded.
demo_packaging_20261018.regression_callout: The first failed RunUAT -build also deleted Binaries/Win64/UnrealEditor-NaiwaRuntime.dll, which made the next cook abort with 'game module NaiwaRuntime could not be found'. Rebuilding Nai_LongEditor restored it; always confirm that DLL exists before cooking.
demo_packaging_20261018.blocker_zen_oplog: First full cook succeeded (0 errors, 12 FText-only warnings, 1m31s) but staging failed with 'Failed to read op from Zen oplog/Windows HTTP 404' because the UnrealPak/Zen instance could not see the cook oplog. Setting bUseIoStore=False and staging a classic pak removed the dependency; stage+pak+archive then finished in 35s.
demo_packaging_20261018.engine_assets_gap: First smoke run reported burst=0 and 'Failed to find object NiagaraSystem /Niagara/DefaultAssets/Templates/Systems/RadialBurst'. Checkpoint VFX plus /Engine/BasicShapes and /Engine/EngineMaterials are loaded through dynamic paths too, so those directories were added to AlwaysCook and the package was rebuilt.
